build_DETRsegm: build a DETRsegm model wrapping a DETR backbone to predict segmentation masks alongside class and box outputs
create_MaskHeadSmallConv: create a MaskHeadSmallConv convolutional head that uses FPN-style upsampling with group norm to generate segmentation masks
create_MHAttentionMap: create an MHAttentionMap module that computes 2D attention softmax weights between query embeddings and memory features
run_dice_loss: run the dice_loss function to compute a DICE loss between predicted mask inputs and binary target masks
run_sigmoid_focal_loss: run the sigmoid_focal_loss function to compute RetinaNet-style focal loss with configurable alpha and gamma parameters
